Resolves the Verifiable Trust state for a DID. Always returns the trust-core fields (`did`, `trusted`, `evaluatedAtTime`, `evaluatedAtBlock`, `expiresAtTime`, `corporationId`); every other section is opt-in via its request selector. Point-in-time is selected via the `At-Block-Height` header.
